readout_other: LFP and tail/hind-limb EMG; LFP-EMG phase locking value
direction_notes: LIPUS to the tail motor cortex increased LFP-EMG phase synchronization (5-150 Hz); band profile depended on intensity and duty cycle. No increase with hind-limb EMG or V1 stimulation.

timing.protocol_description: Experiment A varied Isppa (1.10 to 0.20 W/cm2) at 50% DC; experiment B varied DC (50, 40, 30, 20%) at 1.10 W/cm2. PRF 1000 Hz, 400 ms sonication, inter-stimulus interval 360 ms; 30 epochs per condition.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty-one BALB/c mice (nine week-old males, body weights ca. 25 g)
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The pulse signals were generated by a single element planar transducer (V301; Olympus, Waltham, MA, USA) with a diameter of 33.3 mm, a fundamental frequency (FF) of 500kHz, and a bandwidth of 340 to 650kHz at 26 dB.
